headline: BI Budget Surplus in 2027 Will Reach Rp65,3 Trillion
summary: Bank Indonesia's draft 2027 annual budget plan (RATBI) projects a surplus of Rp65.3 trillion. The document was reported by CNBC Indonesia.
why: Bank Indonesia is the country's central bank, and its annual budget affects its operating finances and transfers to the state. Its finances are watched as part of Indonesia's broader policy framework.
original_headline: Surplus Anggaran BI pada 2027 Akan Mencapai Rp65,3 Triliun
